definitions.explanation: Used in math and everyday calculations.

definitions.gloss: wrapping up; finishing early; cutting short
definitions.explanation: Used for ending activities or work sooner than planned.

examples.japanese: {小数点|しょうすうてん}{以下|いか}は{切|き}り{上|あ}げてください。
この{計算|けいさん}では{切|き}り{上|あ}げで{処理|しょり}する。
examples.english: In this calculation, we handle it by rounding up.

examples.japanese: {端数|はすう}は{切|き}り{上|あ}げになりますので、ご{了承|りょうしょう}ください。
examples.english: Please note that fractions will be rounded up.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{早|はや}めに{切|き}り{上|あ}げよう。
{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}り{出|だ}したので、{練習|れんしゅう}を{切|き}り{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: It started raining, so we cut practice short.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}を{切|き}り{上|あ}げて、{子供|こども}の{迎|むか}えに{行|い}かなければならない。
examples.english: I have to wrap up work and go pick up my child.

examples.japanese: {通貨|つうか}の{切|き}り{上|あ}げが{発表|はっぴょう}された。
{元|げん}の{切|き}り{上|あ}げは{国際|こくさい}{貿易|ぼうえき}に{大|おお}きな{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}えた。
examples.english: The revaluation of the yuan had a major impact on international trade.

examples.japanese: {為替|かわせ}レートの{切|き}り{上|あ}げにより、{輸入品|ゆにゅうひん}の{価格|かかく}が{下|さ}がった。
examples.english: The currency revaluation caused import prices to drop.

notes:
The noun form of the compound verb {切|き}り{上|あ}げる. Has three distinct meanings depending on context: mathematical rounding, ending an activity early, and currency revaluation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {端数|はすう}の{切|き}り{上|あ}げ: rounding up fractions
- {仕事|しごと}を{切|き}り{上|あ}げる: to wrap up work
- {通貨|つうか}の{切|き}り{上|あ}げ: currency revaluation
- {早|はや}めに{切|き}り{上|あ}げる: to finish up early

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {切|き}り{捨|す}て: rounding down; truncation (mathematical opposite)
- {四捨五入|ししゃごにゅう}: rounding to the nearest number (standard rounding)
- {切|き}り{下|さ}げ: devaluation (economic opposite)
